Definition
[Lipschitz hypersurface] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iii:page-0500 1. appi:1.39\group Distance spheres A subset of a smooth manifold is a Lipschitz hypersurface when in every local coordinate chart it is the graph of a Lipschitz function on an open subset of $\R ^{n-1}$.
